rationale: The only directly relevant evidence-supported optimization is dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE, with the measured P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE experiment showing pip-cache savings), but this workflow already contains a pip cache step in the build job, and P-LIT-GHA-CACHE explicitly lists "An equivalent cache already exists" as a contraindication, so adding or replacing it is not supported. Other candidates do not apply: the build matrix is 1x1 (python-version 3.13 x airflow 3.3.1), so matrix fail-fast (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST) has no effect and its evidence is synthetic with required-check safety caveats; cancel-superseded-runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) is contraindicated because this is a release/deployment workflow gated on an external "Tests done" check; custom and history-based timeouts (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT) require representative successful-run history, but ci_history reports no completed runs; test prioritization/selection and workflow/path filtering would alter required-check coverage on a release pipeline; no Bazel, schedule, or unused-output conditions exist. No supported optimization applies without weakening coverage or violating a contraindication.
